audit_metadata.summary: Critical discrepancies detected across public subscription reachability, Wasmer node count bounds, missing unfinished flags in YAML/subscriptions, Supabase region route inflation, and synthetic route-proof logic. Host proxy isolation is verified PASS.

finding_1_public_subscription_endpoints.dimension: Public Subscription URLs and Relative Paths
finding_1_public_subscription_endpoints.rule_violated: Rule 3 (Only relative paths, no full HTTPS URLs) and Rule 4 (Evidence root is only local machine path)

evidence.endpoint_test_result: URLError: SSL UNEXPECTED_EOF_WHILE_READING across all 8 endpoints
evidence.local_mock_artifact: test_http_subscription_endpoints.py (lines 68-79 spins up mock server on 127.0.0.1:18888)

finding_1_public_subscription_endpoints.analysis: No live public HTTPS subscription endpoint is operational. The domain speedtest.ludash.top maps to a non-routable benchmark IP 198.18.0.109. Evidence files provide only relative paths (/wasmer) or local machine paths instead of public HTTPS URLs.

finding_2_wasmer_physical_node_bound.dimension: Wasmer Physical Deployments vs Published Nodes
finding_2_wasmer_physical_node_bound.rule_violated: Rule 1 (deployment ID count < claimed physical node count)

evidence.reconciliation_evidence: evidence/reconciliation/wasmer_nodes.json (correctly bounds physical count to 4 and deducts alias)

finding_2_wasmer_physical_node_bound.analysis: clash_wasmer.yaml line 149 and evidence/subscriptions/wasmer.json line 6 still publish 5 nodes. The 5th node is an unverified query alias (s=2) pointing to the identical French OVH backend. Although evidence/reconciliation/wasmer_nodes.json has documented the deduction, the published YAML and subscription metadata remain unpruned.

finding_3_supabase_region_route_inflatio.dimension: Supabase Deployments vs Regional Invocation Routes
finding_3_supabase_region_route_inflatio.rule_violated: Rule 1 (deployment ID count < claimed physical node count)
finding_3_supabase_region_route_inflatio.analysis: Supabase possesses exactly 2 physical project deployments. The 16 nodes in clash_supabase.yaml are created via query parameter forceFunctionRegion=<aws-region>. Furthermore, evidence/inventory/summary.json claims 34 verified proxies, conflicting with both physical deployments (2) and clash_supabase.yaml (16). Regional invocation routing must not be conflated with physical deployments.

evidence.unfinished_flag_in_yaml: MISSING in clash_fastly.yaml, clash_netlify.yaml, clash_edgeone.yaml, clash_cloudflare.yaml

finding_4_zero_node_platforms_unfinished.analysis: While evidence/inventory/summary.json correctly records unfinished: true, the actual client-facing clash_*.yaml files and evidence/subscriptions/*.json omit the required unfinished: true flag. Under Rule 2, any zero-node platform lacking unfinished: true fails the audit.

finding_5_speedtest_methodology_and_rout.dimension: Domestic Speedtest Claim and Route Proof Validity
finding_5_speedtest_methodology_and_rout.rule_violated: Rule 7 (CHAINED_ESTIMATE described as direct domestic speedtest)

evidence.socket_dial_method: Direct socket.create_connection from single local/runner host (lines 317, 415)
evidence.carrier_simulation: Loop over ['china-telecom', 'china-unicom', 'china-mobile'] labeling local sockets with carrier ASNs (lines 502-523)
evidence.route_proof_mock_flaw: except Exception: status = 'VERIFIED' unconditionally marks port 53 DNS connects as verified
evidence.legacy_report_claims: orchestration/S3_speed_report.md lines 17-43 claim genuine 3-network pipeline with isolated physical sockets

finding_5_speedtest_methodology_and_rout.analysis: Candidate pool separation into 6120 raw, 348 deduped, and 5772 rejected is genuine. However, speedtesting was executed from a single runner environment and labeled with carrier tags rather than routed through true domestic carrier ingress points. This must be designated as CHAINED_ESTIMATE. In addition, route proof logic contains an anti-pattern that sets status to VERIFIED even on socket exceptions.

finding_6_host_system_proxy_isolation.dimension: Zero-Touch of Host Windows Proxy, TUN, and Registry
finding_6_host_system_proxy_isolation.analysis: Host proxy configuration at 127.0.0.1:7897 is 100% intact. Zero registry modification commands or adapter alterations were detected in the codebase.

finding_7_github_remote_synchronization.dimension: GitHub Remote State and Workflow Synchronization
finding_7_github_remote_synchronization.rule_violated: Rule 5 (40-char SHA), Rule 6 (workflow run URL and artifact digest)

evidence.auto_update_drills_status: Not executed on remote GitHub Actions

finding_7_github_remote_synchronization.analysis: The remote repository default branch main only contains 2 legacy workflows. None of the 13 required V13 workflows have been synchronized or pushed by agent-github-deployer. Artifact storage contains 0 files.

rule_1_deployment_vs_nodes.evaluation: FAIL (Supabase: 2 deployments vs 16 published nodes / 34 claimed; Wasmer: 4 deployments vs 5 published nodes)

rule_4_evidence_root_local.evaluation: FAIL (evidence/deployments/summary.json line 101 uses relative local file path)

rule_6_workflow_url_and_digest.evaluation: FAIL (0 remote artifacts exist on GitHub Actions; V13 workflows have not run)

rule_7_chained_estimate_misrepresented.evaluation: FAIL (Legacy S3 report and ledger described single-host runner testing as direct China 3-network probing)

rule_8_ingress_claimed_as_independent_eg.evaluation: PASS (Cloudflare, Fastly, and EdgeOne are acknowledged as FRONT/ingress-only with 0 verified proxies)

remediation_priorities: 1. Fix DNS record for speedtest.ludash.top or update subscription delivery to working HTTPS endpoints (e.g. GitHub raw or Workers dev).
2. Prune clash_wasmer.yaml from 5 nodes to 4 nodes by removing the duplicate 法国巴黎 02 alias node.
3. Align Supabase reporting to distinguish physical deployments (2) from regional invocation routes (10) and correct summary.json proxy counts.
4. Add unfinished: true to clash_fastly.yaml, clash_netlify.yaml, clash_edgeone.yaml, clash_cloudflare.yaml, and evidence/subscriptions/*.json.
5. Formally designate speedtest methodology as CHAINED_ESTIMATE and fix route proof exception-handling defect in run_speedtest_v12.py.
6. Have agent-github-deployer commit and push all 13 workflow files to remote main and execute remote automated update drills.
